item.title: [News] Red-teaming a network of agents: Understanding what breaks when AI agents interact at scale
item.description: Microsoft Research explores the risks of AI agents interacting at scale, revealing that safe agents may not guarantee a safe ecosystem. Red-teaming a network of agents is a method to identify potential vulnerabilities.

item.title: [News] Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
item.description: Google DeepMind is researching AI-augmented care and developing an AI co-clinician, marking a new model for healthcare. This move aims to improve patient care through the integration of artificial intelligence in medical settings.

item.title: [News] Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance
item.description: Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance in four ways. The assistance is for Data Mining and Modeling.
